content: SendGrid shared-IP plans pool sending reputation across unrelated senders (recommended to move to dedicated IP above ~50k msgs/mo). DKIM/SPF domain authentication is often set up once and silently breaks after DNS/infra changes. Suppression lists must be preserved across any account/key migration or bounce rates spike from re-sending to previously bounced/spam-trap addresses. BYO-key model means each tenant's reputation and authentication is fully isolated per tenant but also fully the tenant's own responsibility.
